title: helianthemum origanifolium var. molle
intro: Helianthemum origanifolium var. molle, commonly known as Rockrose, is a plant species belonging to the Cistaceae family, characterized by its fragrant, white flowers and silvery-green foliage. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin infections. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation, making it a popular choice for aromatherapy and herbal remedies. Bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
